annotations.title: Get Boost plans and checkout links

description: Use only when the person asks about paid promotion for their game. Returns Boost, the paid placement Foundplay sells: each plan's counted plays, days, placements and price, what counts as a play, the refund for plays not delivered in time, and availability. Given a game, also whether a boost can be bought for it and a checkout link per plan. Read-only: the person opens a link, signs in and pays on Stripe themselves; nothing is bought by calling this. Not needed for listing a game.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.

name: get_boost_options

outputSchema.description: Boost, the paid placement Foundplay sells, with checkout links when a game is given.

availability.description: Whether each plan can be bought now.

soldOutUntilAbout.description: Per plan id: about when more opens if it is sold out, or null when it can be bought now.

extension.description: How a slow boost is extended.

canBoost.description: Whether no listing-level block was found.

checkout.description: Per plan id: the checkout link, or null.

eligibilityNote.description: What canBoost does and doesn't mean.

listed.description: Whether the game is on Foundplay.

whyNotBoostable.description: Why it can't be boosted, or null.

plans.description: The plans that can be bought, from Foundplay's plan data.

items.description: A Boost plan that can be bought.

days.description: Days to deliver them, from the boost's actual start.

id.description: The plan's id, used in checkout links.

placements.description: Where the game's sponsored card is shown.

refund.description: What happens to plays not delivered in time.

timing.description: When a boost starts and how its days count.
